limits: Nominal RA023 HAT spacing follows Radxa's shipped 4 x M2.5 x 14.5 mm copper pillars (hat_gap = 14.5 mm, 3.0 mm roof clearance). Accept measured facing PCB gap 14.2-14.8 mm; otherwise adjust hat_gap and reprint only the PoE lid.

Retention: SBC bare edges rest on six DXF-verified perimeter pads (Z 5.8) bounded by eight positive PCB-perimeter locator stops (Z 7.2); lid ribs stop 0.4 mm above component-free top edges without clamping PCBs or loading the conductive pillars.

Physical watchpoints from cold review: verify y_stops_front[1] (1.8 x 1.0 x 5.6 mm post between USB3 and OTG) takes no side-load from real USB-C plug collars and inspect bare_fin_3/4 clearance behind CON1 unpowered before snugging screws.
Acceptance after snugging: seam shadow gap 0.15-0.45 mm on every side (front and rear flush); screw heads at or below floor; zero shelf, insert, or post movement.
Never connect both PoE and USB-C power simultaneously on a PoE-equipped board; leave bare box corner mounting holes empty and shrouded.
No digital check establishes printed tolerance, thread/insert pull-out strength, cable seating, service durability, or powered PLA thermal margin.
